2609.21277.title: How Many Humans Is a Judge Panel Worth?
2609.21277.paper_summary: How many human judgments does a panel of language models represent? The answer depends on what is matched. We audit categorical judge panels against empirical human label distributions, retaining disagreement that binary errors relative to one gold label collapse. We measure spectral residual diversity by matching the participation ratio of a normalized residual Gram matrix to conditionally independent human-reference draws, giving nu_H. We separately match distributional squared error, giving nu_MSE. Across three ChaosNLI tasks, the same 32-judge panels have nu_H=4.24--6.50 but nu_MSE=2.30--3.75. A spectral identity separates the eigenvalues, member energies, and averaging-direction weights that determine error. Realizable hard-label panels show that greater spectral diversity can accompany worse distribution recovery even with equal member energies and nonnegative correlations. In the observed panels, within-size ranking agreement varies sharply by task; some member additions produce conflicting changes that persist across two item halves. The consensus-direction share of centered residual variance is gamma_co=43.8% on MNLI-m and 33.7% on SNLI, quantifying shared variation retained by averaging. We provide aligned votes and analysis protocols for auditing these distinctions. Effective size is therefore a target-specific measurement: spectral diversity and distribution recovery should not be treated as interchangeable measures of panel quality or as general human-replacement rates.
2609.21277.paper_summary_zh: 多少人類判斷被一組語言模型所代表？答案取決於匹配的內容。我們對照實證人類標籤分佈審核類別評審小組，保留相對於一個金標籤的二元錯誤所產生的分歧。我們通過將標準化的殘差 Gram 矩陣的參與比例與條件獨立的人類參考抽樣進行匹配來測量光譜殘差多樣性，得出 nu_H。我們單獨匹配分佈平方誤差，得出 nu_MSE。在三個 ChaosNLI 任務中，相同的 32 位評審小組的 nu_H=4.24--6.50，但 nu_MSE=2.30--3.75。一個光譜身份將特徵值、成員能量和決定錯誤的平均方向權重分開。可實現的硬標籤小組顯示，即使在成員能量相等和非負相關的情況下，更大的光譜多樣性也可能伴隨著更差的分佈恢復。在觀察到的小組中，按大小排名的一致性因任務而異；某些成員的增加會產生持續存在於兩個項目一半之間的衝突變化。集中殘差方差的共識方向份額在 MNLI-m 上為 gamma_co=43.8%，在 SNLI 上為 33.7%，量化了通過平均保留的共享變異。我們提供了對這些區別進行審核的對齊投票和分析協議。因此，有效大小是一種特定於目標的測量：光譜多樣性和分佈恢復不應被視為小組質量的可互換測量或一般人類替代率。
